ns2:course.label: Senior Thesis
ns2:course.description: Research in geology, with thesis; a thesis must be submitted for credit to be received. No graduate credit. May be repeated. A maximum of 10 hours of GEOL 492 plus GEOL 493 may be counted toward graduation. Prerequisite: Consent of supervising faculty member.
